title: LouisAgent.Api.Evals: the overview
caption: What a site's API program takes for its agents' evals: its routes behind the admin key, a desk that runs one run or re-grade at a time in the background and stops it on a person's word, and the work that plays a run over the sessions API.

cards.title: LouisAgent.Api.Evals
cards.text: A site's evals, started, followed and stopped over its own API.

cards.title: The routes
cards.text: The host's evals, a run started, read, stopped and re-graded at its address, an eval's runs, a mark flipped, a conversation as a block for its file.

cards.title: One run at a time
cards.text: A hosted service: a start takes its one slot, a stop cancels the run in it, and the host waits for the run when it stops.

cards.title: A run played and kept
cards.text: The agent asked at the program's own address with its key, or for a re-grade no agent, the run kept after every conversation.

cards.title: Its settings
cards.text: Where runs are kept, which model judges, and where the agent is asked.
